digest.headline: Platform and AI tooling, week 36
digest.intro: Three releases worth a look this week.

items.title: Kestrelbay DB adds point-in-time restore
items.summary: Kestrelbay DB adds point-in-time restore for managed clusters. Restores create a new cluster, so the original keeps running.
items.whyItMatters: Restores create a new cluster, so the original keeps running.

items.title: Bramley Pay changes its webhook signing
items.summary: Bramley Pay moves webhook signing to a new scheme on 13 October. Old signatures keep working for 30 days after that.
items.whyItMatters: Receivers need to update their verification.

items.title: Nettlefold Registry adds artifact signing
items.summary: Nettlefold Registry adds built-in artifact signing. Signatures are checked on pull, and unsigned images can be blocked by policy.
items.whyItMatters: Signatures are checked on pull, and unsigned images can be blocked by policy.

sources.title: Kestrelbay DB adds point-in-time restore
sources.summary: Kestrelbay DB adds point-in-time restore for managed clusters. Restores create a new cluster, so the original keeps running. Restore history is listed in the console with the time range of each backup.

sources.title: Bramley Pay changes its webhook signing
sources.summary: Bramley Pay moves webhook signing to a new scheme on 6 October. Old signatures keep working for 30 days after that. The dashboard shows which endpoints still verify the old scheme.

sources.title: Nettlefold Registry adds artifact signing
sources.summary: Nettlefold Registry adds built-in artifact signing. Signatures are checked on pull, and unsigned images can be blocked by policy. Keys can be stored in an external key manager.
